title: Fabrication of Custom Agarose Wells for Cell Seeding and Tissue Ring Self-assembly Using 3D-Printed Molds
protocol: Prepare a CAD drawing of the mold in the desired dimensions.
Send the CAD file to a high-resolution 3D printer.
Select the appropriate plastic printing material, with glossy finish.
Thoroughly wash the printed mold with detergent and water.
Measure 25 g of PDMS base on a balance for a mold with specified dimensions.
Add curing agent at a 1:10 (w/w) ratio to the PDMS base.
Stir vigorously until thoroughly combined.
Place laboratory tape around the border of the 3D-printed molds.
Pour the PDMS mixture into the mold and place it in a vacuum chamber to de-gas until bubbles are released.
Cure the PDMS at 50 °C for 2–4 h, or until solidified enough to remove.
Remove the laboratory tape and carefully extract the PDMS negative.
Incubate the PDMS at 60 °C for an additional 1 h after removal from the mold.
Wash the PDMS thoroughly with detergent and water to remove any residue.
Make a 2% (w/v) agarose solution in DMEM.
Autoclave the agarose solution.
Pipet 4 mL molten agarose into an autoclaved PDMS negative.
Pipet agarose directly into the posts of PDMS negatives.
Remove air bubbles with a pipet tip.
Do not overfill molds; ensure the top surface of the agarose is flat.
Transfer cooled agarose wells from PDMS negatives using blunt forceps into a well of a 6-well plate.
Submerge the agarose wells in complete culture medium.
Equilibrate overnight at 37 °C in an incubator.

Culture rat aortic smooth muscle cells (RaSMCs) in DMEM containing 10% fetal bovine serum, 1% L-glutamine, 1% non-essential amino acids, 1% sodium pyruvate, and 1% penicillin-streptomycin until they reach 70% confluence.
Rinse plates twice with 5 mL per plate of phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Add 3 ml 0.25% trypsin per 15 cm Petri dish.
Move the plates to a 37 °C incubator for 2–3 min, or until cells have lifted off the plate.
Neutralize trypsin with an equal volume of complete culture medium.
Resuspend cells thoroughly to break up clumps.
Dilute an aliquot of cell suspension 1:1 with trypan blue dye.
Count the cells with a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge the total volume of cell suspension for 5 min at 200 x g.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of 10 million cells per mL.
Aspirate all medium from the agarose mold carefully.
Pipette 50 µL of suspension into each well.
Add 2 mL of fresh medium around the outside of the agarose mold carefully.
Place plates in the incubator overnight (approximately 16 h).
Aspirate the medium from outside of the molds after overnight incubation.
Add 4.5 mL fresh medium to each well so that molds and rings are completely submerged.
Change medium daily.
